reminder.title: Arjitha Seva e-dip registration opens in 1 hour
reminder.message: Arjitha Seva e-dip registration (Suprabhatam, Thomala, Archana, etc.) usually opens at 10 AM and runs through the 20th.

reminder.title: Arjitha Seva payment window opens in 1 hour
reminder.message: The payment window for allotted Arjitha Seva lucky-dip tickets usually opens at 12 PM and runs through the 22nd.

reminder.title: General Arjitha Seva tickets open in 1 hour
reminder.message: General Arjitha Seva tickets (Kalyanotsavam, Unjal Seva, etc.) usually open at 10 AM.

reminder.title: Virtual Seva darshan slots open in 1 hour
reminder.message: Virtual Sevas and their associated darshan slots usually open at 3 PM.

reminder.title: Angapradakshinam tokens open in 1 hour
reminder.message: Angapradakshinam tokens usually open at 10 AM.

reminder.title: Srivani Trust tickets open in 1 hour
reminder.message: Srivani Trust darshan tickets and rooms usually open at 11 AM.

reminder.title: Senior citizen darshan tokens open in 1 hour
reminder.message: Free darshan tokens for senior citizens, the physically challenged, and the medical quota usually open at 3 PM.

reminder.title: Special Entry Darshan tickets open in 1 hour
reminder.message: ₹300 Special Entry Darshan (SED) tickets usually open at 10 AM.

reminder.title: Accommodation quota opens in 1 hour
reminder.message: The Tirumala/Tirupati accommodation (rooms) quota usually opens at 3 PM.
